scripts.name: convert_glb.py
scripts.description: Converts FreeCAD parts into lightweight GLB files for web-based 3D viewing. This script does high quality conversions. It can cause frame rate issues

scripts.name: convert_glb_smart.py
scripts.description: Converts FreeCAD parts into lightweight GLB files for web-based 3D viewing. This will adjust the convert quality based on the freecad file size. (recommend)

scripts.name: convert_step.py
scripts.description: Converts FreeCAD parts into STEP files.

scripts.name: cad_properties.py
scripts.description: Extracts FreeCAD part and assembly metadata, including geometry, materials, BOM information, component references, and assembly placements. Generates metadata.json, bom.json, and assembly.asmj files for PLM processing.

scripts.name: convert_x3d.py
scripts.description: Converts FreeCAD parts into X3D format. Currently not required.
